Licenses: all Apache-2.0 (Qwen3.8 27B and its abliterated variants), checked on ollama.com 2026-10-15. `effort` = the reasoning levels THIS model really honours (OD-74), each mapped to an opencode.json variant ('' = the model default = thinking on). The uncensored/abliterated weights expose only none/on (ollama show: levels false/true), so they get 2 real levels; the original Qwen exposes none/low/medium/xhigh, so it gets 4.
